name: tiny-voca (4.5M English TTS)
purpose: Small English TTS with two voices (F2, M2), 4.5M parameters trained from scratch on about 18 hours of synthetic speech; about 70x real time on four CPU threads (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card)
license.notes: Card table says Apache-2.0; LICENSE file not opened.

architecture.kind: small non-autoregressive acoustic model (4 encoder, 2 prosody, 5 acoustic layers, 192 channels) with built-in waveform generator, 24 kHz, phonemes via 'dizione'

variants.notes: tiny-voca.pt 18.2 MB, model.onnx 21.4 MB, repo 0.11 GB incl. phonemizer data

pc-12gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

pc-16gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

pc-24gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

pc-32gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

mac-32gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

mac-64gb+.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

engine_support.notes: llama.cpp mtmd added 'support tiny-voca' in b12497 (2026-11-18).

strengths: already supported in llama.cpp's mtmd within four days of release
weaknesses: two voices, American English only, 18 h of synthetic training data
soft.maturity: 6.4k downloads, 318 likes in 5 days; single author.

tona_fit.reason: Tiny readout voice; English only, so no use for German users. Interesting because llama.cpp took it so fast: small TTS models are becoming first-class in mtmd.
